answer: Randomized video-free audit lottery: each epoch the beacon picks 5% of identities for a live audit, where the holder must answer three fresh puzzle prompts within 90 seconds and post a 20 POA deposit that is forfeited on failure. A farm of 200 fakes expects 10 audits per epoch, so about 200 POA of deposits at risk and a sonnet-sized crew of human solvers that grows linearly with each added key. Like copper wire heating with more current, detection pulse rises as the farm grows. Validators verify answers and deposits on-chain.
